## Synthesis and synthetic read-only gates

The artifact joins the immutable Wave-8 floor of 11,900 rows at exactly 70 per cell with 1,700 verified W9 rows at indices 71–80. The resulting floor is 13,600 observed rows at exactly 80 per cell across 170 exact cells. The parent remains active with 3,400 reserved slots open toward 17,000.

| Gate | Read-only probe | Success criterion | Falsifier / preserved gap |
|---|---|---|---|
| Demand and repeatability | Compare dated exact-industry workflow traces against the cell atom and dimension; retain denominator and source identity | Repeated workflow need has an attributable operator or empirical receipt | One-off anecdote, missing denominator, or identity overlap leaves demand/quality unresolved |
| Capability and authority | Trace declared capability to direct product/API or empirical receipt; inspect owner and scope | Exact relation and authority boundary are named | Vendor positioning or absent owner receipt leaves capability/authority unresolved |
| Rights and provenance | Read license, source terms, data provenance, retention, and export/exit language | Rights class and provenance/retention/export limits are explicit | No license, ambiguous terms, or unknown provenance stays open |
| Eval and negative path | Define replay, malformed input, timeout, denial, rollback, and audit probes | Expected output, failure handling, evidence receipt, and kill condition are recorded | Missing negative-path receipt or nondeterminism leaves eval unresolved |
| Runtime and portability | Check tenancy, identity, egress, recovery, deployment, and rollback assumptions | Environment and recovery boundaries are attributable | Missing isolation, recovery, or rollback proof stays open |
| Economics and maintenance | Preserve cost units, plan/region/access state, support lifecycle, retention, and update burden | Denominator, support boundary, maintenance owner, and exit path are named | Undenominated metrics, stale pages, or no owner leaves cost/maintenance unresolved |

Every cell retains the machine-readable gap domains demand, capability, quality, rights, authority, eval, runtime, cost, portability, and maintenance. Persistent research gaps remain G-W5-DEMAND-DENOMINATOR, G-W5-CAPABILITY-EXECUTION, G-W5-QUALITY-PUBLIC-MIX, G-W5-RIGHTS-REVIEW, G-W5-AUTHORITY-RECEIPT, G-W5-EVAL-RECEIPT, G-W5-RUNTIME-RECEIPT, G-W5-COST-DENOMINATOR, G-W5-PORTABILITY-RECEIPT, and G-W5-MAINTENANCE-RECEIPT.
